sources.note: Office established for Vermont towns by 17 V.S.A. section 2646 (a selectboard of three members unless the town votes five). The Secretary of State's selectboard directory publishes no Albany roster ('Note: Contact the Town Clerk for more information'), and the Town of Albany has no official website, so no official source found as of 2026-10-17 publishes the board's current members; the post is created as structure only with the statutory three seats, and the memberships await the printed annual town report or a clerk records reply.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact information spreadsheet (last updated June 12, 2026), Albany row: Tonya Coderre, Town Clerk.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers & County Clerks' (January 2026), Albany entry: Tonya Coderre, Clerk.

Office established for Vermont towns by 17 V.S.A. section 2646 (moderator, elected annually). No official source found as of 2026-10-17 publishes the current Albany holder; the post is created as structure only and the membership awaits the printed annual town report or a clerk records reply.

Office established for Vermont towns by 17 V.S.A. section 2646 (board of listers elected at annual meeting; three members serve staggered three-year terms under section 2649). No official source found as of 2026-10-17 publishes the current Albany holder; the post is created as structure only and the membership awaits the printed annual town report or a clerk records reply.

Office established for Vermont towns by 17 V.S.A. section 2646 (auditors elected at annual meeting; three serve staggered three-year terms under section 2651. A town may vote to eliminate the office and engage a public accountant under section 2651b; whether this town has done so is not determinable from published sources). No official source found as of 2026-10-17 publishes the current Albany holder; the post is created as structure only and the membership awaits the printed annual town report or a clerk records reply.
